description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
目前，本接口仅支持白名单用户调用。请提交工单申请。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为30。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
Currently, only users on the whitelist can invoke this API. Please submit a ticket to request access.

## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for a single Alibaba Cloud account is 30 when calling this API.

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot reset-device-timeline --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-instance-id iot-v64000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot ResetDeviceTimeline --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-v64000000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
